category_title: Elementary students with mild/moderate autism and significant vocabulary deficits
minimal_context: The student is participating in a 10-minute play session with grocery store and kitchen toys in a sectioned-off hallway area.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have 10 minutes to play in the hallway area. You can use the grocery store and kitchen toys.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What are you going to do with the store?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you ask your partner to play with you?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands awkwardly in silence, producing no requests to the peer and making fewer than five comments total for the session.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We have 10 minutes to play in the hallway area. You can use the grocery store and kitchen toys.

STUDENT: Store. Store. Store.

TUTOR: What are you going to do with the store?

STUDENT: Store.

TUTOR: Why don't you ask your partner to play with you?

STUDENT: (Stands awkwardly in silence, producing no requests to the peer and making fewer than five comments total for the session.)
